painpoints.title: ER Communication Gap
painpoints.desc: Patients say "I feel dizzy" but clinicians need standardized severity, onset, associated symptoms. 15 min wasted per visit.
painpoints.consumer: ER patients (all ages), triage nurses, emergency physicians
painpoints.market: 130M US ER visits/year. $328B US emergency medicine market. Every hospital has this problem.

painpoints.title: Scattered Health Records
painpoints.desc: Vaccine records in 5 portals. No single source of truth. Switch doctors = start from scratch.
painpoints.consumer: Patients who switch providers, travelers, parents tracking kids' vaccines
painpoints.market: 330M Americans with fragmented records. $7.2B health information exchange market.

painpoints.title: Language Barriers in Healthcare
painpoints.desc: Non-English speakers can't describe symptoms accurately. Translators are scarce. Misdiagnosis risk.
painpoints.consumer: 67M US residents who speak non-English at home, medical tourists, refugees
painpoints.market: 67M LEP (Limited English Proficiency) individuals in US. $3.1B medical interpretation market.

painpoints.title: Doctors Re-Asking Questions
painpoints.desc: Nurse asks intake questions, doctor asks the same ones. Patient repeats story 3 times.
painpoints.consumer: All patients visiting any clinic or ER, front-desk staff, nurses, doctors
painpoints.market: 1B+ annual US outpatient visits. Each redundant intake = 10-15 min wasted clinician time.

painpoints.title: Pet Owners Can't Describe Symptoms
painpoints.desc: Even worse than humans. "My dog is acting weird" tells the vet nothing.
painpoints.consumer: 67% of US households (86.9M homes) own a pet. 200M+ vet visits/year.
painpoints.market: $35.9B US veterinary services market. Pet owners spend avg $367/year on vet visits.

painpoints.title: Health Literacy Gap
painpoints.desc: Patients leave the doctor not understanding their diagnosis, medications, or next steps.
painpoints.consumer: 36% of US adults have basic/below-basic health literacy. Elderly, immigrants, low-income.
painpoints.market: Low health literacy costs US $236B/year in avoidable ER visits and complications.

ideas.title: AI Triage Intake on Tablet
ideas.desc: Visual pain scales + body maps + AI follow-up questions. Generates triage summary for clinician.

ideas.title: Multilingual Voice Health Assistant
ideas.desc: Speak in any language, AI translates to clinical terms and asks structured follow-ups.

ideas.title: Personal Health Knowledge Graph
ideas.desc: Ingest all records, check vaccine status, drug interactions, travel recommendations.

ideas.title: Diagnosis Explainer
ideas.desc: After visit: explain diagnosis in plain language adapted to patient literacy level.

ideas.title: Vet Triage Mode
ideas.desc: Same triage pattern for pet hospitals. Species selector + common pet emergencies.
